mutations.name: an rpc is judged on its p50 instead of its p95
kills: the perf tab an rpc over its budget shows the warning badge

mutations.name: a route is judged on a different percentile than its p95
kills: the perf tab a route past three seconds shows the warning badge and a quick one does not

mutations.name: the toggle keeps asking for the 15 minute window
kills: the perf tab the 24 h toggle shows that window's rows

mutations.name: the p95 column is hidden on a phone too
kills: the perf tab on a phone only the name and the p95 column stay visible

mutations.name: a wait is judged on its p50 instead of its p95
kills: the perf tab ranks waits by owner seconds as the server sent them and badges a p95 past its command's budget
